Results.ReviewText: I was pretty happy with my previous grill, but last December a windstorm blew it off the deck and down a flight of stairs and smashed it up quite a bit. So I decided I'd replace it with a Weber, and I'm glad I did. The Spirit II E-310 is the perfect size for my deck. The porcelain grids work much better than the ones on my old grill -- easy to clean and no sticking. I've grilled a whole sea bass, a little basket of baby potatoes in their skins, cabbage slices, lamb chops, asparagus stalks, and a lot of other stuff. (Eventually I'll get around to steak and burgers.) The heat is even, so everything on the grill cooks at the right temperature and nothing burns. The controls give a smooth transition from low to high with no big jumps in between. It's obviously built for long service. I'm definitely keeping this one, and will lash it to the deck posts to protect it during the winter.
Results.Title: Excellent results on fish, chops, potatoes

Results.ReviewText:
Great family-sized, corner-of-the-deck grill. I was a cook for 10 years and a chef for 5, and have owned and used more than a few grills over the years. I would have liked to see a bigger pivoting upper deck on this mid-sized model as the stationary one included is quite small for roasting veggie trays or keeping medium-large steaks hot.

Also with the wheels on the right, and the fold-down side-tray on the left, rolling it around without having the tray popping off the cleats is a challenge. Simply putting the folding tray on the same side as the wheels, or having an option to permanently fix it in place, would have made this a non-issue.

I was concerned when I saw the 5 heat distribution plates and only 3 burners. But heat seems pretty even-spread, with minimal hot-spots.

First impressions, are great; these two minor gripes the only things keeping it from being a 5-star grill for me. The 10 year warrantee on all parts seems to be worth it's weight. The open, simple build will make cleaning inside and out relatively fast and easy.
Results.Title: Good to Great

My only issue with it has been starting it. Using the starter I can get it to light 20-30% of the time. I usually have to use a propane barbecue lighter to get it lit. I reported my issue to the company and they sent me a whole new assembly, which I installed with the same results. I suppose I should have reported the issue back to the company, but really didn't know if it would make much difference. In hindsight I should have let them know, as they probably figured the new system worked.
Results.Title: Fantastic to cook with

Results.ReviewText: My wife got me one for a birthday gift.  Mainly to replace the old grill.  I love the grill and use it often, once or twice a week in the two months I've had it.  The grill is great quality and does great work with no noticable hotvor cold spots.  My only minor complaint is that the top rack is not large enough.   The old grill had a top rack large enough for 8 burgers for the reverse searing way I like to cook. This one will barely hold 6, disappointing and I'm wondering if Weber makes a wider top rack for this grill.  I would be happy to purchase if it is out there.
Results.Title: Need a larger top rack

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought this 4 months ago and it’s been heavily used since I assembled it (pretty easy)! My family grills out frequently, especially on weekends, and the Spirit II has always, always started easy, gotten up to high temp fairly quickly and I’ve yet to find a cool spot anywhere across the grilling surface, which the grilling area has been plenty big for anything I’ve wanted to throw on it. Also, have yet  to have ANY kind of “flare up”. Gets a great amount of mileage out of the propane tank and is easy to keep clean. I highly recommend this unit if you have ever wanted a Weber!
Results.Title: Great grill, y’all!
